integrity: All finite checks are explicitly bounded; the arbitrary-dimension result rests on the complete normal-form and module-counting argument. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Free nonunital cube-zero associative algebras only; full-automorphism conjugacy and scheme structure not addressed; full Lewis (2006) survey inaccessible; independent literature-priority review remains necessary.
title: A modular conjugacy obstruction and exact census of anti-involutions on free cube-zero algebras
